definition: Complete administrator consent and then user enablement so Claude can reach SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams.
outcome: the M365 connector is consented in the organization's Microsoft tenant and a signed-in user can query SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams from Claude

records.outcome: the Microsoft 365 connector is added for the team with organization-wide permissions granted, so members can connect it
preconditions: Claude user with Owner or Primary Owner role (Team and Enterprise plans)
Global Administrator access to Microsoft Entra tenant
A work or school Microsoft account on a Microsoft Entra tenant
Active Microsoft 365 accounts for all users (Team and Enterprise plans)
steps: Navigate to Organization settings > Connectors
Select Add, then All available
Find Microsoft 365 and select "Add to your team"
Connect individually and grant organization-wide permissions
Optionally restrict user access or revoke specific permission scopes

evidence.quote: Find Microsoft 365 and select "Add to your team"

records.notes: Labeled "Automatic Setup (Recommended)"; phase 1 of a two-phase admin-then-user setup.

records.outcome: the member's Claude account is connected and authenticated to Microsoft 365, so Claude can query SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams
preconditions: Administrators have enabled the connector (Team and Enterprise plans)
A Microsoft Entra Global Administrator has granted one-time tenant consent
steps: Navigate to Customize > Connectors
Find Microsoft 365 and click "Connect"
Authenticate with Microsoft 365 credentials
records.notes: On Free, Pro, and Max plans no organization-level setup is needed and the user connects from Customize > Connectors in claude.ai directly; same steps, different precondition.

records.outcome: Anthropic's connector app has a consented service principal in the tenant, a desktop client app registration exists with access_as_user granted, and its tenant and client IDs have been sent to Anthropic for allowlisting
preconditions: Global Administrator or Cloud Application Administrator in the Entra tenant
Claude Desktop deployed on third-party inference
steps: Copy the Directory (tenant) ID from Entra admin center > Overview
Open the adminconsent URL for that tenant with the Anthropic connector client_id
Review the delegated Graph permissions and select Accept

In Entra admin center > App registrations > New registration, name it Claude Desktop, set account types to this directory only, and add redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/callback under Mobile and desktop applications
Select Register and note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID
Under API permissions > Add a permission > APIs my organization uses, search Anthropic, select Delegated permissions > access_as_user, then Add permissions
Select Grant admin consent for your organization
Email your Anthropic representative or open a support ticket with the Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID
Wait two to three business days for allowlist confirmation

evidence.quote: A tenant administrator must consent to Anthropic's multi-tenant connector app once for the organization.

records.notes: FedRAMP and GovCloud deployments use a different connector app ID and hostname, obtained from an Anthropic representative.

records.outcome: the Microsoft 365 remote connector is configured in Claude Desktop with the tenant's client ID, tenant ID, and scope, and the configuration is deployed to devices

steps: Open the Claude Desktop in-app configuration window
Open Connectors
Select Add server > Microsoft 365
Enter the Application (client) ID as Client ID
Enter the Directory (tenant) ID as Tenant ID
Enter the access_as_user offline_access scope string
Select Save
Deploy the configuration through your device-management tool

evidence.quote: Select **Save**, then deploy the configuration through your device-management tool as usual.

Set oauth.scope to the access_as_user offline_access scope string
Deploy the configuration through your device-management tool

records.outcome: a dedicated public client app for local mode exists in Microsoft Entra with a loopback redirect URI, public client flows allowed, and admin-consented delegated Graph scopes, and its client and tenant IDs are noted
preconditions: Microsoft Entra admin center access
do not reuse the desktop client app registered for the remote connector
steps: In Entra admin center go to App registrations > New registration
Set Name and set Supported account types to accounts in this organizational directory only
Under Authentication open Redirect URI configuration and select Add redirect URI
Choose the Mobile and desktop applications card (Windows, UWP, Console)
Leave suggested URIs unchecked, enter http://localhost in Custom redirect URIs, and select Configure
For brokered sign-in on managed devices, add the per-platform broker redirect URI to the same platform via Edit, then Save
Set Allow public client flows to Yes and select Save
Under API permissions > Add a permission > Microsoft Graph > Delegated permissions, add the scopes the connector will request
Select Grant admin consent for your organization
Note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID from the overview page

evidence.quote: Note the **Application (client) ID** and **Directory (tenant) ID** from the overview page.

records.notes: Admin stage of the local-connector path; the user still signs in afterwards. A Conditional Access policy blocking device-code flow is recommended, scoped to All resources.

evidence.quote: open **Connectors**, select **Add server**, and choose **Microsoft 365** under the **Built-in** group.

records.notes: The server ships inside the app; it activates only from managed configuration and users cannot add it themselves.

steps: Open Customize → Connectors in Claude Desktop
Select Connect on the Microsoft 365 connector
Complete sign-in in the system account-picker dialog shown by the native authentication broker
If the broker is unavailable, complete sign-in in the system browser that opens instead

evidence.quote: the connector appears in **Customize → Connectors** in Claude Desktop. Sign-in starts when the user selects **Connect**.

records.notes: User half of the M365 connector setup; the admin stages (app registration, consent, config deployment) are in earlier parts of this page.

records.outcome: the deployed configuration determines whether the connector's sign-in uses the device authentication broker or the system browser
preconditions: `required` only where every device runs Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 or later
`required` is not supported on Linux
steps: Set the microsoftAuthBroker key in the managed configuration
Leave it at auto to use the broker where available and the browser otherwise
Set disabled to always use the browser
Set required to make sign-in fail rather than fall back to the browser
Set required only after every device that receives the configuration is on Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 or later

evidence.quote: Set `required` only after every device that receives the configuration is on Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 or later

records.outcome: Windows devices meet the requirements for brokered sign-in, so tokens carry the device identity claim that device-based Conditional Access evaluates
preconditions: Claude Desktop version 1.13576.0 or later
Windows 10 or later (desktop editions)
steps: Confirm devices run Claude Desktop 1.13576.0 or later on Windows 10 or later
Join or register the device to Entra ID (Entra joined, hybrid joined, or registered)
Mark the device compliant in Intune or hybrid-joined as the Conditional Access policy requires
On the local-mode app registration, open Mobile and desktop applications
Register ms-appx-web://Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin/APPLICATION_CLIENT_ID, replacing APPLICATION_CLIENT_ID with the Application (client) ID from step 1

evidence.quote: The broker redirect URI is registered on the local-mode app under **Mobile and desktop applications**, with `APPLICATION_CLIENT_ID` replaced by the Application (client) ID from step 1

records.notes: Windows broker is Web Account Manager (WAM), built into Windows.

records.outcome: macOS devices meet the requirements for brokered sign-in through the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in and the registered broker redirect URI
preconditions: Claude Desktop version 1.19367.0 or later
steps: Confirm devices run Claude Desktop 1.19367.0 or later
Enroll the Mac in an MDM, register it in Entra ID, and mark it compliant
For non-Intune MDMs, use the partner device-compliance integration that reports to Intune and Entra
Install Intune Company Portal, which provides the broker
Deploy an Extensible SSO configuration profile of type Redirect pointed at the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in through MDM
Register msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop://auth on the local-mode app under Mobile and desktop applications
Remove the msauth.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop.helper://auth entry if the registration lists it

evidence.quote: **Intune Company Portal** is installed; it provides the broker.

records.notes: The macOS redirect URI appears under the iOS / macOS section after saving.
